checklist.question: Is a Work Authorization Permit and/or Variance in place and at the work front to bypass/defeat a Safety Critical Device?
Alternative controls in place to manage risks while Safety Critical Device is defeated?
Is there an emergency response plan during safety critical device defeat?
Safety critical device defeat/bypass is documented?
Safety critical device defeat/bypass is communicated?
Have crane computer by-passes/alarms been tampered with or disabled?
Tools equipped with built-in safety features? (spring loaded safety knives, deadman switches, etc.) And safety features not bypassed
Are tools with triggers being used properly? The trigger is not locked down
Are tools with guards and handles being used properly

expectations.question: Has the job been stopped in the event of an imminent hazard?
